summary: Sandbach United's pre-season preparations are in full swing with just one week until the 2026/27 campaign kicks off! The squad has been bolstered with exciting new signings and a returning player, while the club has also unveiled three brand new kits and is actively seeking sponsorship partners. A recent friendly against St Helens showed the team's competitive spirit, though they'll be looking to sharpen up their finishing as they aim for promotion this season.
